title: 歌舞路ライツ
artist: 歌舞路ブギー・クラブ
caption: Early 1980s Japanese funk and boogie instrumental, city pop style. Driving slap bass and four-on-the-floor drums with handclaps, scratchy rhythm guitar, bright synth brass riffs, sparkling electric piano, a gritty tenor saxophone lead melody, analog synthesizer solo. Energetic, glamorous, neon nightlife. Warm analog tape sound. Instrumental, no vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration B).
